# the contributor audit: moving normals, coverage cost, and small-budget menus

Sources:
`candidate 0e4cb84a76d46e82`
and `candidate ea5641bf79da4654`.

the companion verifier reports 26 exact symbolic checks passed.

The regular reduced Hessian follows from the implicit function theorem
under the expressly stated C2 and positive-definite normal-Hessian
hypotheses. The singular quadratic range condition is correct, and the
fourth-order example correctly prevents treating its pseudoinverse value
as an automatic Hessian of the nonlinear minimum. The constrained penalty
is the least-norm solution of the transformed linear incidence equations;
the pseudoinverse retains redundant rows.

For the actual three-triangle body, the archived exact paired-tail theorem
and ordinary triangle equality case certify all global minimizing normal
directions. The cap formula follows from actual edge intercepts. Its
normal Hessian is diag(2,3), and direct differentiation confirms both
mixed terms and the displayed physical Schur form. The affine radius
mode is genuinely compatible in both signs. The uniformly bounded
nearby bodies permit one common finite tilt interval; continuity and
the complete initial menu justify the positive gap and local branch
selection used for the actual depth assertion.

The balanced integer drift is exactly the criterion for this chosen
positive circuit to cover every continuous fiber space at both endpoint
bases. Imposing it restores the stated quadratic cost; independently
optimizing the three tilts loses an actual neighborhood of an endpoint
centroid. Variable balancing weights have the same first-order drift
constraint because the original tilts vanish. The normalized stress
then restores exactly the raw total-volume curvature.

This selected-circuit requirement is stronger than a full ownership
cover, as the source explicitly explains. Exposed endpoint fibers have
exactly their own ordinary maximum depths, by finite isolating tilts.
Their slack proves the actual local global-depth claim. Cyclic symmetry
and convex depth superlevel sets place the middle maximum at its
centroid; the finite full-small/empty-large cap proves the endpoint
winner at parameter one half.

For the separate small-budget menu, the clipped cap formula handles
empty, proper, and full statuses. The global one-fiber inequality is
valid on both radius regimes and is sharp only at the original triangle.
Summing it therefore proves actual global fixed-budget maximality over
all compatible families in the stated fan. The affine radius variation
preserves every compatibility equality, is parity-neutral, and has the
reported strictly negative full Lagrangian curvature.

Those small-budget caps miss the centroids and do not form a critical
cover. This explicit missing premise prevents using that construction
as a counterexample to OC. Conversely the optimized-normal formula does
not itself supply a simultaneous improving motion at a general
below-target extremizer. Neither note is promoted to that conclusion.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
